details.effect: Rush. [fanfare] Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may summon a Passion follower from among them. Bury the rest. [act] [cost02], Lesson (2): Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may summon a Passion follower from among them. Bury the rest.

issues: Remove `fanfare` from `keywords`; Fanfare should be represented as an ability timing, not a keyword.

The Fanfare effect incorrectly uses `searchDeckSummonMultiple` with `maxTotalCost: 6`; the card says you may summon a Passion follower from among the top 2 cards with no cost limit, so it should summon at most 1 matching Passion follower from the looked-at cards and bury the rest.
The activated ability is missing the Lesson (2) cost. In addition to paying 2 PP, it should require banishing 2 Magical Item tokens/cards from your EX area.
The activated ability also incorrectly uses `searchDeckSummonMultiple` with `maxTotalCost: 6`; it should summon at most 1 Passion follower from among the top 2 cards, then bury the rest.
